properties.description: Planned 2026-10-07, build order 6 of 7, after F2 so the offers are worth reading. F1 widens unreviewed_ideas, or adds a sibling finding, to requirements and accepted ideas that relate to nothing beyond their author, project or satisfaction. F5: capture-intent runs relation_candidates after a requirement is written and puts the candidates to the person, as link-ideas does.
properties.name: Missing links are looked for on requirements and accepted ideas, not only open ideas (F1), and capturing a requirement offers its likely relations (F5)
